scope: read-only current production resolvers, isolated B06 debug gate; no simulation, no save reads or writes

methodology.runtime: Godot 4.6.3 headless; isolated candidate flag; production resolver and real encounter_plan called without changing data
methodology.ordinary_scope: Every chapter roster template evaluated at chapter first/last zone levels. This is a numerical envelope, not a claim each template spawns in the first room. actual_spawn_rows gives actual finite plans by room/zone. Duplicate identical member rows collapse; not population counts.
methodology.static_budget: 8784 combinations, real DamageResolver; basic_H expression copied verbatim from HeroAbilities.preview_powers because standalone SceneTree cannot compile Game-dependent helper. Leveled/naked/equipped stats supplied by parallel hero audit. No crit, chain, weakpoint, status, skill rotation, shielding, target uptime, mechanics, movement or incoming misses. Enemy coefficient_1 includes actual tier+difficulty skill factors but is not every skill.
methodology.skills: Catalog current real command/timing, active and difficulty variants; cooldown is ability readiness, not attack interval. Basic/special FSM uses tell+lock+execute/stages+recovery and chase; no honest single attack_interval for all monsters. B05/06 active cooldown6–14/6–14s; shared basics fill between specials. B05 boss CDs7,12,14,18,20,24; B06 7,12,16,17,20,24s; phase/availability select commands.
